high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "richardbranson." The post features a video showcasing a Wayve self-driving car navigating through one of the busiest areas of central London. The video is split into two frames: the left frame shows the view from the car's windshield as it drives down a street lined with buildings and parked cars, while the right frame displays the interior of the car, showing a person sitting behind the steering wheel with a laptop on the dashboard.
